text:
Alex: Quick heads-up — my doc started me on a new med this week that can cause daytime drowsiness. Can we talk about reducing meetings and shifting more sprint work async for ~6 weeks? cc @Marta
Marta: Thanks for flagging, Alex. Totally fine to discuss. Do you want fewer meetings overall or just moved to different times? We can also do async standup.
Alex: Fewer meetings is best. Standup via thread would work. Also, overnight on-call may be rough for the next 6 weeks — can I request a temporary on-call reduction or shift swap? I can provide a short note from clinician if needed.
Priya (People Ops): Hi @Alex — we can absolutely start the interactive process. A clinician note helps but is not required to start an interim accommodation. We typically log a temporary schedule adjustment + review date. I can DM the accommodation form and next steps. :handshake:
Jamal: I can swap overnight shift with Alex for the next 6 weeks, happy to cover urgent pages.
Marta: Really appreciate that, Jamal :pray:. Alex — would you like a 15-min to confirm specifics (start date, which meetings to skip, who covers what)?
Alex: Yes please — 15 min sounds good. Prefer to start Monday. For meetings: skip design review and move engineering sync to async thread. Oncall swap with Jamal is fine. I'll upload a short clinician note tomorrow.
Priya (People Ops): Noted. I'll record a temporary accommodation effective Monday, review in 4 weeks, and we can extend if needed. The form has fields: limitation, effective dates, proposed adjustments, and whether documentation provided. Everything is confidential and only shared with those covering shifts. I'll DM the link to the form and confirm the review date.
Marta: Thanks Priya. Alex — we'll mark calendar for the 15-min check-in this afternoon to confirm the handoffs.
Alex: Thanks everyone, really appreciate the quick response.
Priya (People Ops): DM sent with the form link and next steps. If you prefer we can do a quick phone call instead of uploading docs.
Marta: Team check — Jamal, can you post a quick calendar invite for the overnight swap and add a note in the oncall rota?
Jamal: Done, invite sent and rota updated.
Alex: Got it. Will upload the note later today and join the 15-min. Thank you.
Priya (People Ops): Marking thread as in-progress. We'll follow up at the 4-week review or earlier if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
